div.div: 6 تراضخنا We cast, or shot, one at another; syn. تَرَامَيْنَا: (S, K:) or تَرَاضُخٌ signifies a people's shooting arrows, one at another: (JK, TA:) and تراضخنا بِالسِّهَامِ We shot, one at another, with arrows: (TA:) and هُمْ يَتَرَاضَخُونَ بِالنُّشَّابِ They shoot, one at another, with arrows. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
